note: Seed registry for key prison and stealth beats; all future player-facing features must add a contract and pass production gates.

beats.intent: Connect Snake's deliberate capture to loss of equipment and regain player control.
beats.trigger: Choose surrender at the processing post after prisoner intelligence.
beats.action: Player can move, aim camera and inspect immediately.

visual.foreshadow: Equipment removed in earlier capture scene; prison cell reads as confined
visual.impact: Confiscation notification appears when mission capture commits
visual.aftermath: Snake resumes control in unchanged uniform, without weapons

audio.origin: Close cell hum and restrained ambience
audio.response: Equipment removal cue is audible, not a sustained alarm

state.persistence: Checkpoint resumes with no repeated capture cue

verification: Capture once; immediate control; save/reload without duplicate

beats.intent: Schneider provides credible architectural context without giving away the prison secret.
beats.trigger: Player manually opens transceiver or accepts subtle incoming contact.
beats.action: Open the optional pre-capture architectural contact. The cell receiver offers Big Boss; inspection remains immediately available.

visual.foreshadow: Architectural seams can be seen before radio use
visual.impact: Provisional non-pausing HUD transcript with Schneider 120.79 and Big Boss 120.85; 3D listening animation and portrait are missing.
visual.aftermath: Radio UI exits without camera teleport

audio.origin: Dry receiver voice rather than 3D world broadcast
audio.response: Placeholder UI confirmation only; no licensed voiced dialogue or authentic transceiver beep is supplied. Future spatially non-diegetic receiver EQ and sound mix must retain threat cues.

timing.start_event: Optional manual player request at any time; unobtrusive incoming prompt only when pacing hint is eligible.

state.transaction: No mission progress flag committed by dialogue
state.persistence: Optional call is replayable and does not gate a wall
state.ai_knowledge: No guards triangulate an internal radio voice

verification: No call required to breach; transcript readable; channel identity correct
Confiscation does not block the transceiver; it does not pause or prevent movement
No automatic radio VO or clue is required to breach; live dialogue not voice-recorded

beats.intent: Player notices that a repaired section may not be sound.
beats.action: Face the repaired panel and strike deliberately. Each accepted impact advances its damage; the third opens the passage.

visual.foreshadow: Masonry seam and conduit join distinguish patch without glowing arrows
visual.aftermath: Surface remains recognizably damaged until breached

audio.origin: Localized hollow sound compared with solid material
audio.response: Acoustic response only where surface is struck
audio.non_audio_equivalent: Visible wear and descriptive caption or inspect affordance

timing.start_event: First mission progress checkpoint; hints at 28s/75s since advance, held while actively exploring until 6s/10s quiet (anti-stall overrides after 100s/150s).

state.transaction: No hidden timer unlock; wall is eligible immediately
state.persistence: Keep partial damage through checkpoint reload and opened panels after breakthrough.
state.ai_knowledge: Only meaningful audible impacts create guards' sound cues

verification: Early solver can breach at t=0; hints only after inactivity; compare acoustic/visual comprehension
Under active movement or camera scan, early hints must be held back; immediate solver can breach with no delay.

visual.foreshadow: Surface deterioration and clear exit route

beats.action: Slide, peek, release, knock or leave. Breakable walls cannot auto-attach.
